decision: Editorial links from these publications to the owner's portfolio domains are plain followed links: no nofollow, no sponsored, no ugc. rel="sponsored nofollow" stays only on links that are genuinely paid or affiliate (client work, tagged affiliate URLs) and on untrusted third parties. Read by scripts/affiliation.py (the one rule that writes rel) and by scripts/validators/validate_portfolio_link_policy.py (the guard).

caps.why: Measured 11 Oct 2026: 141 of professionalresourcelibrary.com's 178 portfolio links went to approvalprep.com (79%), and 26 founder-operator pages all linked the same A Player Mode homepage. No target domain may take more than a quarter of one site's portfolio links, and no single URL more than ten, so the links read as citations spread across subjects rather than a pipe into one site.
caps.campaign_floors: A campaign in data/portfolio-backlink-campaigns.json keeps at least its minimum_rendered_coverage links: those rows are kept before any other link to the same domain competes for the domain's quota.

retired_link_claims_note: Sentences already published in page bodies that state portfolio links carry rel="sponsored nofollow" or pass no ranking signal. Both stopped being true on 11 Oct 2026. scripts/install_editorial_chrome.py rewrites each `old` to its `new` (raw and HTML-escaped) on every page, and each `new` is exactly what scripts/lib/page_composer.py now composes, so a re-rendered page and a corrected page are the same bytes. Never delete an entry: pages still carrying it would stop being corrected.
